attestations.text: SHIH Jun-chang 施閏章 (T. 尚白, 屺雲, H. 愚山, 矩齋, 蠖齋), Jan. 6, 1619–1683, Aug. 5, poet, scholar, and official, was a native of Hsüan-ch'êng, Anhwei. His mother died when he was three (sui) and his father when he was nine (sui), leaving him to be brought up by a younger brother of his father.
施閏章，字尚白，號愚山，宣城人。

accounts.evidence: 施閏章，字尚白，號愚山，宣城人。祖鴻猷，以儒學著。子姓傳業江南，言家法者推施氏。
